description: Source code for QuicChromiumPacketReader class handling UDP packet reading with support for multiple packets and platform-specific optimizations.

classes.name: QuicChromiumPacketReader
classes.description: Handles reading UDP packets for QUIC protocol, supporting multiple packets and platform-specific optimizations.

methods.name: StartReadingMultiplePackets
methods.description: Attempts to read multiple packets if platform supports it, with fallback to single packet reading.

methods.name: ProcessMultiplePacketReadResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a multiple packet read operation, handling errors and passing packets to visitor.

methods.name: OnReadMultiplePacketComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of multiple packet read.

methods.name: StartReading
methods.description: Begins reading packets, using multiple packet read if supported, otherwise single read.

methods.name: ProcessReadResult
methods.description: Processes the result of a single packet read, handling errors and passing packets to visitor.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of a single packet read.
